sources.title: National and regional planning policy
sources.verified_claim: Havering identifies national planning policy, Planning Practice Guidance and the Mayor's London Plan as higher-level policy context; the page does not itself determine parcel compliance.

sources.title: Help us with our planning policy
sources.verified_claim: Havering maintains a stakeholder database to notify residents, businesses and others of opportunities to participate in development of planning policies; participation status is not a development outcome.

sources.title: Socio-economic data
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's socio-economic evidence catalogue includes borough, health and climate-related documents from multiple years; evidence age and purpose must be retained rather than treated as a current parcel forecast.

sources.title: Town centre uses and hotels
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's town-centre and hotel evidence includes retail, ground-floor use, public-house and visitor-accommodation studies mainly from the 2010s; it remains policy evidence rather than current parcel demand proof.

sources.title: Sustainability appraisal
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's evidence catalogue retains the January 2020 Sustainability Appraisal and appendix used for the revised Local Plan; document age is explicitly retained.

sources.title: Lambeth Local Plan 2021
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth confirms the Local Plan 2021 was adopted on 22 September 2021 and remains part of the statutory development plan while a new Local Plan is being prepared.

sources.title: Adopted plans
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's adopted-plans page records the statutory plan documents and supporting evidence used for adopted area and development-management plans; older evidence is not treated as current parcel proof.

sources.title: New Enfield Local Plan
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's New Local Plan page provides the emerging plan, statutory assessments, evidence-base links and examination material; emerging policies and hearing documents are kept distinct from adopted planning status.
